protocol.funding: rates times a fair sign coin per settlement hour (R-E)
protocol.g6: paired lag test (R-C) on 20 equally spaced lags with the speed limit 0.5 (R-N)
protocol.membership: the real monthly schedule (the kernel's rule on the real activity)

verdict_unit_only.denominator: DEV-positive evaluated pairs (pooled, KP-016); evaluated pairs (families)
verdict_unit_only.rule: G6 threshold = the LARGEST of G6_GRID whose null pass rate (Tier-1 passes / DEV-POSITIVE EVALUATED pairs, KP-016) is <= NULL_PASS_MAX under BOTH nulls AND whose every family's null pass rate (its Tier-1 passes / its EVALUATED pairs; a missing rate fails) is <= FAMILY_PASS_MAX under BOTH nulls, where a null fails every threshold when a family has fewer than FAMILY_EVALUATED_MIN or the null fewer than NULL_EVALUATED_MIN of its DESIGNED pairs evaluated, when it has fewer than DEV_POSITIVE_MIN DEV-positive evaluated pairs, or when more than NULL_FAULT_MAX of its CANDIDATE pairs ended in a fault (a submitted pair neither evaluated nor liquidated, or a chosen draw that failed stage 1), every evaluated p must lie on its lattice, and the stored rows must be exactly the protocol's design; then oracle power at true Sharpe 1.5 >= POWER_MIN for BOTH speeds under BOTH nulls, with every oracle level's achieved mean VAL Sharpe within RHO_BOUND (0.1) of nominal; otherwise STOP
